info.name: CNF C&F Agent — SAP APIs (runtime-certified 2026-08-25)
info.description:
Shree Cement CNF C&F Agent — environment-driven SAP API collection.

CURRENT MATERIAL CERTIFICATION — QS4/700, 2026-08-21
  API_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV;v=2 is registered with LOCAL as the default system alias.
  A single external deep insert created delivery 9004953174 from STO 5600084209/000010.
  HTTP 201, OData GET readback, and LIKP/LIPS persistence were confirmed.

EVERY request is labelled with its evidence status:
  [PROVEN]    executed against SAP, response captured
  [UNTESTED]  endpoint confirmed to exist, never executed
  [REJECTED]  executed and refused — kept deliberately as proof
  [NO HTTP]   not callable over HTTP at all; spec only

SAFETY
  Mutating requests require a valid CSRF token and matching Postman session cookie.
  Create DI additionally requires confirmCreateDI=YES and resets it to NO after execution.
  The ;v=2 service-path segment is mandatory.
  Use the supplied QS4/700 environment for the certified Create DI flow.
  TLS uses an internal CA; install the CA chain for pipelines or disable SSL verification only in controlled testing.

item.name: 4 — Submit MIGO: goods receipt against STO  [PROVEN — real document]
item.description:
Certified 2026-08-25 in QS4/700. Created material document 5007138597 / year 2026 against STO 5600084239 item 00010 (2 EA, material 17035056, plant 1022, storage location FKGU). Verified three ways: OData $expand re-read, MSEG direct database read, and EKET showing WEMNG move from 0.000 to 2.000.

REUSE: 5600084239 is now fully received and cannot be used again. The next candidate with stock in transit and an open goods receipt is 5600084238 item 00010, 4 EA, same material and plant. A valid item needs BOTH a posted 641 (stock in transit exists) AND EKET WEMNG < MENGE.

## Request field mapping

Header (A_MaterialDocumentHeader):

| OData property | SAP field | Value used | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| PostingDate | MKPF-BUDAT | /Date(1787616000000)/ | Epoch ms, UTC midnight. Must fall in an open MM period. |
| DocumentDate | MKPF-BLDAT | /Date(1787616000000)/ | |
| GoodsMovementCode | BAPI GM_CODE | 01 | 01 = goods receipt for purchase order. |
| MaterialDocumentHeaderText | MKPF-BKTXT | CNF API TEST | Free text, useful for tracing test documents. |
| ReferenceDocument | MKPF-XBLNR | not sent | Vendor delivery note. Optional; unused for STO receipts. |
| CtrlPostgForExtWhseMgmtSyst | - | not sent | DELIBERATELY OMITTED. Can produce a delivery instead of a material document. |

Item (to_MaterialDocumentItem):

| OData property | SAP field | Value used | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Material | MSEG-MATNR | 000000000017035056 | Sent zero-padded to 18. |
| Plant | MSEG-WERKS | 1022 | Receiving plant. |
| StorageLocation | MSEG-LGORT | FKGU | Taken from EKPO-LGORT of the PO item. |
| GoodsMovementType | MSEG-BWART | 101 | Receiving movement for a two-step STO. |
| GoodsMovementRefDocType | BAPI MVT_IND | B | THE DECIDING FIELD. B = movement for a purchase order. Omit it and the PO fields are rejected. |
| QuantityInEntryUnit | MSEG-ERFMG | 2 | See caveat below. |
| EntryUnit | MSEG-ERFME | EA | See caveat below. |
| PurchaseOrder | MSEG-EBELN | 5600084239 | Predecessor. |
| PurchaseOrderItem | MSEG-EBELP | 00010 | Sent padded; returned unpadded as 10. |

## Response field mapping

| OData property | SAP field | Observed | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| MaterialDocument | MKPF-MBLNR | 5007138597 | The authoritative key. |
| MaterialDocumentYear | MKPF-MJAHR | 2026 | Part of the composite key; comes FIRST in the URL. |
| InventoryTransactionType | - | WE | WE = goods receipt. |
| CreatedByUser | MKPF-USNAM | QNOVATE8 | |
| CreationDate | MKPF-CPUDT | 2026-08-25 | |
| CreationTime | MKPF-CPUTM | PT12H41M16S | ISO 8601 duration, not a clock time. |
| GoodsMovementCode | BAPI GM_CODE | 01 | Echoed. |
| to_MaterialDocumentItem | - | EMPTY on create | Documented SAP behaviour. Always read back. |
| (HTTP header) location | - | .../A_MaterialDocumentHeader(MaterialDocumentYear='2026',MaterialDocument='5007138597') | Carries the created key; usable instead of parsing the body. |

## Verified independently in the database

MSEG for 5007138597/2026 item 0001: BWART 101, MATNR 000000000017035056, WERKS 1022,
LGORT FKGU, MENGE 2 EA, EBELN/EBELP 5600084239/00010, SHKZG S, BUKRS 1000, WAERS INR.

EKET for 5600084239/00010: WEMNG moved from 0.000 to 2.000 against MENGE 2.000.

## Two things NOT established

1. ERFMG/ERFME versus MENGE/MEINS could not be distinguished on this test, because the
   entry unit EA is also the base unit for this material. A material whose order unit
   differs from its base unit is needed to confirm which pair QuantityInEntryUnit and
   EntryUnit actually populate.
2. MSEG-DMBTR came back 0.00. For a stock transfer the receiving value derives from the
   issuing plant's valuation. Whether zero is correct for this material, or indicates it
   is unvaluated, must be confirmed with MM before any value field enters the contract.

request.description:
CREATES A REAL SAP MATERIAL DOCUMENT.

THE FIELD THAT DECIDES THIS CALL: GoodsMovementRefDocType = "B". It is the OData equivalent of MVT_IND in BAPI_GOODSMVT_CREATE, where B means goods movement for a purchase order. Without it SAP returns 400 with MM_IM_ODATA_API_MDOC/011 "Property PURCHASEORDER is not supported for GoodsMovementType 101". That message names the PO properties and points at the wrong field - the missing field is the reference document type. See the negative request in this folder.

The goods receipt references the PURCHASE ORDER, not a delivery. Confirmed from three live receipts in QS4 (5600084213, 5600075302, 5600075921), all with LIFNR and LFBNR blank.

item.name: 5 — Standard OData: STO create  [REJECTED — keep as proof]
item.description:
EXECUTED 2026-08-19. Returned HTTP 400 with a 742-byte error body. This request is retained deliberately: it is the evidence that the standard purchase-order service cannot create stock transport orders.

Errors returned:
  APPL_MM_PUR_PO/064  Use purchase order type Standard (NB) or a type copied from NB
  APPL_MM_PUR_PO/065  Use a supported purchase order item category

Why this matters for ZP06, their real STO type:
  QS4 T161: ZP06 -> BSAKZ = T, BREFN = UBF  (a copy of UB, not of NB)  -> fails 064
  QS4 EKPO: PSTYP = 7 on live STO 5600084210                          -> fails 065

Two independent locks. Master data, plant pairing and transporting ZP06 to DS4 change neither.
v1.8 pairs API-11 with this service. That pairing is wrong and should be corrected in the workbook.

item.name: 7 — NOT CALLABLE OVER HTTP  [NO HTTP — spec only]
item.description:
STOP. Nothing in this folder can be sent.

These are RFC function modules. They have no URL, no HTTP verb, and no OData entity set. They are documented here as request-contract specifications so the team knows the exact payload the moment an exposure layer exists — and so nobody wastes a day hunting for an endpoint that was never there.

TO MAKE THESE CALLABLE, exactly one of:
  (a) a custom SEGW OData service wrapping the BAPI — this is the ZCNF_* pattern the business hard-stopped on 2026-08-14;
  (b) a SOAP service generated over the BAPI via SOAMANAGER;
  (c) the calling system speaks RFC directly (needs an SAP connector, not Postman).

The SD_SCDS_* freight modules are worse than the BAPIs: they are neither released NOR RFC-enabled, so options (b) and (c) do not apply to them either. They need an ABAP wrapper before any exposure is possible.
